Client Agreement – Nutrition & Lifestyle Programs

This Client Agreement outlines the terms and conditions governing participation in any nutrition and lifestyle program offered by Karpagam Ramesh (M.Sc. Clinical Nutrition), including but not limited to the One-Time Consultation, 1-Month Healthy Eating Program, and 100 Days wellness Program (“the Program").

By enrolling in any of these programs, the client acknowledges and agrees to the following:

1. Program Overview

Each Program is designed to provide personalized dietary guidance and lifestyle modification support under the supervision of a Clinical Dietitian.

The focus is on developing sustainable eating habits, improving nutritional balance, and promoting long-term wellness — without crash diets, extreme restrictions, or shortcuts.

2. Assessment & Plan

  • All programs begin with an initial nutritional assessment conducted via Zoom, voice call, or in-person meeting.
  • Clients are required to share recent medical reports, prescriptions, and relevant health details before the assessment for accurate diet planning.
  • Based on the assessment, a personalized meal plan will be designed considering the client's health goals, dietary preferences, and lifestyle.
  • Meal plans may be revised periodically based on progress, feedback, or any change in medical condition.

3. Payment Policy

  • Full payment must be made prior to the start of the program.
  • Payments are accepted through UPI transfer (details will be shared privately).
  • All fees are non-refundable and non-transferable, as the plans are fully customized for each client.
  • In the unlikely event that the dietitian is unable to continue due to an emergency or unavoidable circumstance, the client will be offered:
    • A partial refund for the remaining period, or
    • The option to resume the program at a later date, once services resume — whichever the client prefers.

4. Follow-Up & Communication

  • All communication and follow-ups will take place via WhatsApp, email, or scheduled calls.
  • Response time is generally within working hours (10 AM – 7 PM, Monday to Saturday).
  • Sundays and public holidays are considered non-working days.
  • If the dietitian remains unavailable for more than 5 consecutive working days without prior notice, the client's active program duration will be extended accordingly.
  • Clients are expected to share regular updates, including food logs, progress photos, and feedback for accurate monitoring.

5. Client Responsibilities

  • Clients are responsible for following the prescribed meal plan and lifestyle recommendations consistently.
  • Any medical changes, new medications, or discomfort must be reported to the dietitian immediately.
  • Program success depends on the client's commitment, consistency, and adherence to the plan.
  • Meal plans are personalized and must not be shared, copied, or reused by others.
  • The dietitian will not be liable for unsatisfactory results if the plan is not followed as advised or if the client provides incomplete/incorrect information.

6. Program Duration, Pause & Extension

  • The program duration begins from the date the client starts sending daily food logs or updates (“Day 1”).
  • Clients may take up to 5 days after receiving their meal plan to prepare mentally, shop for groceries, and start the program.
  • In case of medical or personal reasons, clients may pause the program once with prior notice, and resume within a mutually agreed time frame.
  • If the program is paused beyond the agreed period, reactivation may require an additional administrative charge.

7. Confidentiality

All personal, medical, and contact information shared by the client will be treated as strictly confidential and used solely for nutrition planning, progress monitoring, and communication purposes. No data will be shared with third parties without explicit consent.

8. Media & Testimonials

  • Transformation photographs, progress screenshots, or feedback messages may be used by the dietitian for educational or promotional purposes (e.g., social media, website, or workshops).
  • Client identity will remain anonymous unless the client provides explicit permission to disclose their name or image.
  • Content will only be shared after obtaining written or verbal consent.
  • Clients may decline participation in promotional materials at any time without affecting their enrollment in the program.

9. Disclaimer

  • All nutrition plans and guidance provided are for educational and lifestyle improvement purposes.
  • The Program is not a substitute for medical treatment or diagnosis. Clients under medical supervision should consult their physician before making dietary changes.
  • Results vary depending on individual factors such as age, metabolism, medical conditions, and consistency.
  • The dietitian does not promote crash diets, detox cleanses, or supplement-based shortcuts for weight loss.

10. Limitation of Liability

The dietitian shall not be held responsible for:

  • Any adverse health effects resulting from non-compliance with the prescribed plan.
  • Results that differ from expectations due to genetic, medical, or environmental factors beyond professional control.
  • Any loss, injury, or damage arising from the client's failure to disclose medical conditions or medications during assessment.

11. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, and any disputes shall fall under the jurisdiction of Tamil Nadu courts.

Acknowledgement

By enrolling in any program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to abide by the terms of this Client Agreement.

Client Name: __________________________

Signature: __________________________

Date: __________________________

Dietitian: Karpagam Ramesh, M.Sc. Clinical Nutrition

Contact: [e-mail: karpagamdietitian@gmail.com, Ph: 9003143389]
